description: Not every story applies to our situation and thats ok! #careeradvice #lifebydesign #fyppppppppppppppppppppppp #leadershipdevelopment
transcript: It is so important to understand your situation and your circumstance in order for you to adjust and readjust accordingly. Often we get too fixated on things that don't apply to us. We hear stories or we know of situations where other circumstances were different and they had a different result. And we are looking for the same results that others have received. But that is not our circumstance. That is not our situation. And we focus too heavy on what others are outcomes are instead of looking in our own internal world and focusing on what we can do to adjust in order to get to where we need. It is important to focus on yourself.
